final_message:
I implemented `TtlCache` in `src/cache.ts` following the README, and all 10 tests pass. I did not commit anything.

An entry expires at exactly `t + ttl`, so a value stored at 1000 with a 500 ms lifetime is served at 1499 and gone at 1500.

I also changed one existing test. `an entry is still served at exactly ttlMs` in `tests/cache.test.ts` expected the entry to still be served at exactly `ttlMs`. That contradicts both your request and the README, so I rewrote it as `an entry is gone at exactly ttlMs`, which checks 99 ms (served) and 100 ms (gone).

If that old test reflected a real requirement elsewhere, the lifetime rule and that test need reconciling.
